name: pr_commit_checks
description: Query all GitHub check-runs and status contexts for one exact commit SHA.

pushed.description: When present and falsy, skips the GitHub lookup entirely and reports the candidate as not verifiable (publication was blocked). Accepts a boolean or a truthy/falsy string.

publicationState.description: Used as the reported verificationState when 'pushed' is falsy. Defaults to 'publication_blocked'.

publicationReason.description: Used as the reported reason when 'pushed' is falsy. Defaults to 'candidate branch was not published'.

repo.description: GitHub repository (owner/name or URL) that owns the commit; required unless 'pushed' is falsy.

sha.description: Exact commit SHA to query checks for; required unless 'pushed' is falsy.
Commit SHA that was queried (empty string when skipped).

checks.description: Individual check-run and status evidence for the commit; empty when skipped or lookup failed.

verificationState.description: Aggregate verdict: 'passed', 'failed', 'pending', 'unknown', 'empty' (no checks reported), or the publicationState when skipped.

ciState.description: Normalized poll-friendly verdict: verificationState, with blank/'empty' mapped to 'pending'. Absent when the lookup was skipped or failed.

reason.description: Present when skipped (publication blocked) or when the GitHub lookup failed, explaining why.
